params.label: The edition a server is when PORTAL_EDITION is not set

params.name: rows
params.label: Each edition: its name, tagline, first screen and the screens it shows

description_nl: One codebase, two products (owner, 2026-09-18: 'SteadyMove is tv + new features'). A server is told which it is by PORTAL_EDITION (a hosting fact, set in its service file). This chip says what each edition is called and which of the catalog's screens it shows; the framework's own admin screens are always there. tv is frozen - new screens are added to steadymove only, except what the owner names for both (2026-09-20: frames 'Frames from a video' and images 'Image Library' on tv AND SteadyMove; on tv the library has no Studio to send a picture to, so the page hides Use for a shot / character - the server says can_use). tour: the sign-in page's own tour video, served from static/tour (video, captions, poster). selling: the cards on the sign-in page, each [icon, title word, line word] (words are ui.app, with the edition's words_prefix). jump_signin: a Sign in button at the top of the sign-in page on a phone, where the form sits below the whole pitch. 2026-09-28: guideme (Guide Me Builder) on SteadyMove only. 2026-09-28 owner ("make Katha standard as tv and sm"): doors - another address of the same edition (katha.valuestream.in on SteadyMove) with its own name, line under the logo, first screen, pitch words (words_prefix) and cards; the same shell, sign-in card and menu, never a page of its own. read (Read stories) is SteadyMove's shelf screen, katha's first screen. A door's screens: the ONLY portal screens its menu and search show (Katha: Watch, Read, Listen - no editing; Continue this story opens SteadyMove). The framework's own admin screens stay for those who may open them. A door's launch: the Launch Studio button (top right) - for each of the door's hosts, the workshop address to open (katha.localhost opens the local SteadyMove). 2026-09-30 owner (Katha Groups): groups - make a group of people by email, they accept, works are shared with it - on SteadyMove (beside Publish & Circles) and on the Katha door. site_hides (2026-10-01 owner: "I don't want Katha in sm's menu"): screens the edition's OWN address leaves off its menu and search because a door shows them (Katha's reading screens live on katha.valuestream.in); they still open from a link or a bell. site_sends {this address: the door's address}: a link to a site_hides screen opened HERE is sent on to the door (2026-10-01 owner: "send Katha links to katha.valuestream.in") - bookmarks and bells land on Katha.
weight_basis: Owner-only (audience admin): this decides what a whole product shows to everyone.
